name: Distro 10 - (5g) Baller Bucket - Han Solo Burger
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, bulk size. The Distro 10 Han Solo Burger Baller Bucket packs a full 5 grams of live resin — full-spectrum concentrate extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with. Bold, flavorful, and built for people who go through it.

Han Solo Burger is a heavy-hitting, savory strain built for fans of loud, funky terps. Expect a pungent profile: sharp garlic and onion funk up front, layered with peppery spice, deep earthy notes, and a gassy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a potent, deeply relaxing calm that settles the body and makes it a strong pick for evenings.

Why you'll love it:

5G live resin — bulk value in one bucket, fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Han Solo Burger flavor — pungent garlic-and-onion funk with pepper, earth, and gas
Bucket packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Distro 10 Han Solo Burger is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
